name: Ithorian herd ship
description: Ithorian herd ships were a class of massive city-ship used by the Ithorians as a home away from home. They were based on the repulsorlift herd-cities of their planet, but were enclosed for space travel. The ships travel the galaxy on a predetermined course set by the herd, but return to Ithor once every three years in an event known as the Herd Meet.

data.name: Ithorian herd ship
data.complement: Numerous shuttles, landing craft, and utility vehicles
